items.title: How Mycom optimized its SaaS data fabric with Amazon S3 Access Points and Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP
items.summary: Mycom collapsed two copies of its telco assurance data (one file store, one object store) into a single copy on Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP, served through both NFS and the Amazon S3 API using S3 Access Points. Learn how this removed duplicate storage, reduced cost and carbon, and kept analytics and operational apps consistent.
items.creator: Zhiying Lee
